ios.desc:
See what's happening around you right now — no account, no sign-up, no profile. Just open WiSaw and start sharing.

Snap a photo, post a video, and instantly connect with everyone nearby. Your feed is always relevant — sorted by distance and time, not algorithms or followers.

HOW IT WORKS

Open the app — you're already in
Take a photo or video — it's shared with people near you
Scroll the feed — see what others are seeing right now
That's it. No setup. No profile to build. No followers to chase.

FEATURES

▸ Location-based feed — closest content first, always fresh
▸ Truly anonymous — no name, no email, no phone number, ever
▸ AI image recognition — every photo is auto-described by AI
▸ Real-time comments — join conversations on any post
▸ Waves — organize your photos into smart collections
▸ AI auto-grouping — let AI sort your photos into Waves for you
▸ Friends via QR code — connect privately without revealing identity
▸ Bookmarks — save your favorite posts
▸ Community moderation — anyone can remove inappropriate content
▸ Dark mode — easy on the eyes, day or night
▸ Video support — share short videos, not just photos


PERFECT FOR

▸ Events — Concerts, weddings, festivals, sports games
▸ Campus life — See what's happening across your school today
▸ Travel — Explore a new city through the eyes of people there now
▸ Neighborhoods — Your hyper-local community bulletin board
▸ Conferences — A shared visual feed for every attendee

PRIVACY YOU CAN VERIFY

WiSaw is fully open source. Every line of code is published on GitHub. We collect no personal data — not because we promise, but because the app literally never asks for it. There's nothing to leak because there's nothing to collect.

YOUR CONTENT, YOUR COMMUNITY

See something you don't like? Delete it. Every user has the power to remove content, which means the community self-moderates. The result: a cleaner, more relevant feed for everyone.

Download WiSaw and see what's happening around you.

android.desc:
Free Stock Photos, Royalty Free Stock Images & Copyright Free Pictures, User Generated Content, Unaltered, Authentic, Taken With Phone Cameras.

No registration, no sign in -- just open the app, start taking photos and short videos, and see what's posted by other people nearby today.
This is the most minimalistic social sharing possible, yet, it's probably the most relevant one as well. It's relevant in time and space. You only see what may potentially matter to you. You do not choose what you see. As such, you do not have to spend time and effort making connections, describing your profile etc. You just start using it. 
The feed will always stay relevant for your location and time. If you see something you do not like -- just delete it, which will have an effect of drastically increasing the quality of the content for everyone, reducing the noise.
This works best for events, large and small. Wedding or celebration party, at a beach or a park, student at a campus, or a conference attendee, or a group of fans at a football game -- these all will benefit from WiSaw and will definitely make it a lot more fun.


There are 3 guiding principles WiSaw is built upon:

- Extreme simplicity 
The "WiSaw" app has only 2 screens. The more complex the app gets, the easier it becomes for the business to manipulate the users behavior and the data they provide. We believe that "Less is More".

​- Absolute privacy
It's achieved by never asking a user for any personal information (not even login).  There is no data -- there is nothing to leak. All data we collect is short lived -- everything disappears from the system after short while -- again, this makes it difficult to leak the data which we do not have.

- Complete transparency  (product)
To make a software product useful and interesting for the users, it does need to have access to some data. All data we collect is public. Everyone can see and do everything  with it -- there are no special roles and permissions. We do not moderate any of the content the users upload -- we believe in the power of the community to do the right thing. If anyone finds some content to be offensive, they can simply delete it, which will also improve the quality of the data for everyone else. 

​
- Complete transparency  (company)
How do you know, we are not lying to you? Simple -- every line of code we write is published to the OpenSource repository in GitHub. Check it out:  https://github.com/echowaves
